subject: design/argus-journal-type-recovery
statement: Argus draft commits use slug-scoped first-PR paths; lock preparation verifies source bindings, rejects multi-parent source commits before rebase, refreshes valid stamps, shares the installed cache with its temporary worktree, and leaves unstamped and generated commits unstamped. After a valid delivery ledger is committed, the shared predicate also admits only its own three-digit numbered plan Markdown/JSON under the configured literal plan root and its native problem captures; actual-lock planning readiness remains separate.
intent: Keep ordinary single-user draft pushes and lock preparation attributable without losing merge-only edits.
rationale: The old docs-only scope rejects draft rounds; copied bindings fail after a parent change; refreshing a stale source binding would launder it; plain rebase skips merge commits; and a linked worktree omits the ignored installed binary cache.
fit_criterion: Boundary, real-hook rebase, stale-source and merge-source refusal, installed-cache, attribution-gate, and prepare-lock integration tests cover the changed production units.

provenance.note: Carry forward the unchanged implementation-scope-and-rebase decision Decision-01M48AE1G1NQWX743YQ8S6FAK7 to the proposed successor design. Its original statement, intent, rationale, fit criterion, code associations and relationships are retained; the predecessor remains historical evidence. New journal classification semantics require exact-head review and merge of this Source proposal.
